block_05_direct_answer.title: Direct answer
block_05_direct_answer.body_html: Off-plan and ready property solve different buyer needs, so neither is universally better. For family buyers, compare price, payment timing, financing, construction risk, handover certainty, immediate use or rent and visibility over the finished property. Choose the route whose trade-offs best match the buyer’s timeline, cash flow and tolerance for uncertainty.

items.answer: Off-plan and ready property offer different trade-offs rather than a universally better choice. Model deposits, instalments, financing and completion payments for both routes instead of comparing only the initial purchase price.
items.question: How do off-plan and ready property compare?

items.answer: Neither off-plan nor ready property is automatically better for every buyer. Account for construction, delivery and specification risk in off-plan while checking condition, refurbishment and existing-building risks in ready property.
